N_final_rule: max(n_required(2v3), n_required(2v4a)) - never averaged or pooled
binding_note: This N_final is NOT yet authorized for a main evaluation manifest - a separate, explicit go/no-go, given its scale relative to every prior batch in this project.

2_vs_3.note: b_plus_c must equal the discordance count already reported; b_minus_c is the PILOT's own raw effect estimate - NOT used as the MDE, which remains the pre-specified 0.05 from the cost matrix (§16.1). Reported for transparency/audit only, per review's explicit request.

2_vs_4a.note: b_plus_c must equal the discordance count already reported; b_minus_c is the PILOT's own raw effect estimate - NOT used as the MDE, which remains the pre-specified 0.05 from the cost matrix (§16.1). Reported for transparency/audit only, per review's explicit request.

parameterization_note: Sample size formula is parameterized by (d, MDE), not (b, c) or (b/c ratio) - these are equivalent parameterizations of the same 2-parameter family (b=n(d+MDE)/2, c=n(d-MDE)/2), and (b,c) individually are not required as formula inputs because MDE is a pre-specified design target (from the cost matrix, §16.1), never estimated from the pilot's own directional split - the pilot supplies ONLY the nuisance parameter d, per §16.5's prohibited-use list.
